dossiers.financial_spine: India's near-monopoly warship+conventional-submarine builder (P-15B/P-17A/P-75, ~81% GoI), an elite ~36% ROCE franchise but priced for perfection. Reported PAT (Rs2,578cr FY26) is ~35% other income (treasury on customer-advance cash, not free) and margins are provision/write-back-lumpy; core shipbuilding EBIT is ~17% normalizing to ~15%. The over-rate is a VALUATION + ORDER-LUMPINESS problem (order book shrank to Rs20,535cr, ~1.6x, with the entire Rs1-lakh-cr bull case gated on the still-unsigned P-75I), NOT an earnings-fraud problem.
dossiers.drivers: Milestone-based revenue on P-15B/P-17A/P-75; order INFLOW (P-75I ~Rs70k cr FinMin-approved but CCS-pending, plus 17B/MCMV/LPD RFPs — none booked); Rs1,139cr treasury/other income (35% of PBT) on advance-funded cash; margins swung by ~Rs1,000cr onerous-contract provisions vs ~Rs200cr LD write-backs; defence-indigenization + Navy capex supercycle tailwind.
dossiers.dependencies: Single customer (MoD) + government order TIMING/PRICING (P-75I CCS is the binary thesis gate); execution on lumpy warship/sub programs; other-income dependence on a customer-advance pool that fell 33.5% in FY26; defence-capex cycle; OFS overhang (81% GoI); peers BEL/HAL are complements, Cochin/GRSE smaller — competition is not the core risk.
dossiers.forensics: Other income ~35% of PBT (recurring but advance-funded). Core EBIT ~17% vs headline flattered by write-backs; mgmt guides normalized ~15%. Net cash ~Rs13,097cr BUT ~Rs10,303cr is customer advances (contract liabilities, -33.5% YoY) -> only ~Rs2-3k cr truly free. FY25 CFO -Rs2,891cr = advance/WC timing, NOT paper-profit (operating core solidly profitable; engine's own OCF rule exempts shipbuilders). ROCE 36%, ROE ~29-37% — elite but decelerating. Governance clean PSU. Valuation P/E ~36.6 / P/B ~9.7x rich vs 5% FY27 growth. EXIT is JUSTIFIED as risk-off, though HOLD/TRIM is the more precise call.

valuation.method: normalized PAT ~Rs2,400-2,700cr (strip provision-write-back-flattered peak) x 30-34x defence-peer multiple (discount to Cochin 53x/GRSE 40x froth), net-cash haircut to genuinely-free cash; CMP sits upper-middle of fair band

dossiers.prediction: Base: range-bound to mild-underperform Nifty by 3-8% over 90d absent a signed order (5% FY27 growth guide + margin normalization cap the multiple). Bull-flip falsifier: signed/CCS-cleared P-75I (~Rs70k cr) -> book triples, +15-25% outperformance, exit wrong. Bear-thesis falsifier: two consecutive quarters >15% clean YoY revenue with >=17% margins AND order book back above Rs35k cr -> air-pocket thesis dead.

dossiers.financial_spine: KEI is India's #2/#3 wires & cables player riding a structural Rs1.2tn market growing 15%+/yr (electrification, data-centre, T&D, real-estate cabling); FY26 revenue Rs11,748cr (+20.7%), PAT Rs918cr (+32%), a genuine 5yr 23%/27% rev/PAT compounder — not base-effect or cyclical peak, though FY26's margin step-up was partly commodity/FX-aided with soft underlying volume. The mid-2025 de-rate is a VALUATION-MULTIPLE compression driven by an exogenous new-entrant FEAR (Adani/UltraTech/Birla), not a fundamental break — brokers cut target multiples ~20% but left near-term earnings intact, and management flags capacity CONSTRAINTS (can't make enough) rather than demand loss. Composite ~71 is only marginally over-rated: a top-quartile net-cash compounder with clean books earns a high score, but thin margin-of-safety at ~50x + newly-capped pricing power warrant a ~1pt shave, not a hard cut.
dossiers.drivers: Retail/dealer distribution 54% of sales (higher-margin B2C house/winding wire + cables, brand+distribution-moated, mix rising) via 2,125 dealers; institutional/EHV & LT power cables 42% (electrification, data-centre, renewables, T&D capex demand); capex-led volume unlock (Sanand+Chinchpada greenfield breaking a real capacity constraint -> guided 17-18% volume FY27, ~20% FY28); EPC deliberately capped ~2.6% (WC-heavy, low-turn) — good capital allocation.
dossiers.dependencies: New deep-pocketed entrants with captive copper — UltraTech/Aditya Birla (Birla Cable, Rs1,800cr, live Dec-2026) & Adani (Kutch Copper JV) threatening pricing discipline; copper/aluminium input & the monthly cost-pass-through mechanism (calibration risk as competition intensifies); working-capital cycle (cables are WC-heavy — inventory days the key watch item); Sanand capex execution/ramp (Phase-1 commissioned Dec-2025 after 6mo delay, Phase-2 Q4FY27); real-estate/infra/data-centre capex demand cycle; exports (weak in FY26).
dossiers.forensics: FORTRESS balance sheet: borrowings only Rs253cr vs cash+investments ~Rs1,500cr -> net cash ~Rs1,300-1,500cr, net-debt/EBITDA ~ -0.9x, D/E 0.04 (78% below 10yr median). QIP Rs2,000cr @Rs3,800 (Nov-2024) fully pre-funds the Rs1,900-2,000cr Sanand greenfield (Rs464.5cr still unutilized Mar-26) -> NO leverage risk from capex. Accruals: FY26 OCF Rs840cr vs PAT Rs918cr -> OCF/PAT ~0.92 (healthy); but FY25 OCF was -Rs32cr (WC blowout) and FCF negative two years (FY25 ~ -Rs726cr, FY26 ~ -Rs412cr) — investment-phase drainage covered by QIP+accruals, inverts as Sanand ramps, NOT distress. YELLOW FLAG: inventory days rising 79->99 (watch >110 = channel-stress signal); mitigant — debtor days IMPROVING 73->57 (argues against loose-credit sales stress). ROCE ~19-20%, ROE 14.8%, EBITDA margin 11.8% FY26 (guided DOWN to 10.5-11% FY27). Governance CLEAN: promoter 35% zero pledge, CARE 'CG 2+', 50% independent board, Pawan Shubham & Co. unmodified audit — no discount. Valuation still RICH post-de-rate: ~50x TTM P/E (screener 51x), ~7x P/B, in line with Polycab ~47-60x / RR Kabel ~44x / EV-EBITDA ~30x — premium multiple for a business whose pricing power is entering a contest.

valuation.method: earnings x multiple (~35-42x FY27E EPS ~Rs115-128), peer-relative + growth-adjusted (PEG ~2 on ~22% growth); low=competition/margin-cap scenario ~ Kotak Rs4,200, high=structural-compounder ~ MS Rs5,213/consensus Rs5,244

dossiers.prediction: Base (HOLD): tracks Nifty +/-5% over 30/60/90d, range ~Rs4,500-5,300, awaiting Q1FY27 (Jul-Aug26) Sanand volume proof + pricing-discipline evidence. BULL falsifier (->upgrade BUY, outperform Nifty >10%): Q1/Q2FY27 prints 17%+ volume with EBITDA margin held >=10.5% AND inventory days stop rising -> competition fear proven overdone, re-rate Rs5,400-6,000. BEAR falsifier (->TRIM, underperform Nifty >10%): EBITDA margin <10.5% on competitive pricing, OR inventory days >105-110 without volume follow-through, OR UltraTech launches aggressive retail pricing (Dec-2026), OR volume miss <15% -> de-rate toward Rs4,200/sub-Rs4,000.

dossiers.financial_spine: Global off-highway-tyre (OHT) export cyclical (~75-80% exported, Europe #1, US ~10%, India the new outperformer); ~6% global share, replacement-led, backward-integrated (carbon black). FY26 is a GENUINE cyclical/geopolitical TROUGH — record volumes but PAT -25% YoY / EBITDA -10% on EU destocking, a 50% US tariff, natural-rubber inflation, forex MTM and heavy-capex depreciation; not structural rot. Leverage is real but MODEST: net debt ~Rs895cr = 0.37x EBITDA, FCF negative only because of chosen growth capex (OCF/PAT ~1.8x, cash-backed). Call: this is an OVER-RATE-corrected-to-FAIR name, not an over-corrected bargain — the de-rate removed froth on peak earnings; hold.
dossiers.drivers: EU agri + global industrial/OTR demand (destocking ending, gradual recovery); volume growth (FY26 record, +15% QoQ Q3); EBITDA margin (23-25% norm, compressed to ~22.7% FY26 on rubber+mix+tariff); EUR/INR FX (MTM losses hit Q1FY26 by Rs154cr); carbon-black backward integration cushioning RM; India as new growth leg; 3-5% price hikes in flight vs 7-8% RM inflation.
dossiers.dependencies: EU farm/machinery cycle & restocking; US tariff path (50%->reportedly ~18% relief = key swing); ocean freight/Red Sea; raw materials (natural rubber Rs18,500->21,600/100kg, crude derivatives, carbon-black feedstock); EUR/INR; execution of Rs6,800cr capex incl. margin-dilutive PCR/TBR on-highway entry (-70-80bps); competition (Michelin/Trelleborg/Titan/MRF).
dossiers.forensics: Net debt ~Rs895cr (Mar-26; up from ~net-flat FY25 on capex) = 0.37x EBITDA, LOW. OCF Rs2,224cr, capex Rs2,504cr -> FCF -Rs756cr (growth-driven, NOT distress); OCF/PAT ~1.8x (clean accruals). Working-capital days negative (-42), inventory 119d, debtor 55d — no channel-stuffing. ROCE compressed to 11% (from 16% FY25 / 23% FY22) — the key watch-item; recovery hinges on new-asset utilization. Margin 22.7% FY26 vs 24-25% norm; Q4 gross margin dipped to 20.45% on rubber. Governance CLEAN: Deloitte joint auditor, no pledge, no promoter loans, promoter 58.3% stable, consistent dividends. Valuation: EV/EBITDA ~20x = 5-yr median (13-yr median 17x, trough 9.65x); P/E ~35x on depressed EPS ~Rs63 = expensive; ~2x MRF's multiple. No trough discount at CMP.

valuation.method: blend: mid-cycle EPS ~Rs77 x 25-28x AND through-cycle EV/EBITDA 14-17x on mid-cycle EBITDA ~Rs2,600cr less net debt Rs895cr

dossiers.prediction: Base (hold): roughly in-line-to-slightly-lagging Nifty over 30/60/90d, range ~Rs1,950-2,300, awaiting rubber roll-over + EU restock + US tariff clarity; mild positive skew if Q1FY27 (Aug-2026) holds EBITDA >=23% with continued volume growth. EXIT-falsifier: Q1FY27 EBITDA margin breaks <21% AND volume growth stalls (flat/neg YoY) while EV/EBITDA stays ~20x -> margin damage is structural. BUY-falsifier (rescue trigger): price retests <=Rs1,750-1,800 (EV/EBITDA ~14-15x) with volumes at records and margin recovering toward 24% -> genuine ~20% MOS; OR US tariff formally <=18% AND two consecutive quarters >=24% EBITDA at current price.
